NONE: A1 every thing, person, etc. in a group of two or more, considered separately
（兩個或兩個以上物或人中的）每個，各，各自
› used to say that everyone likes different things
（用來表示人各有不同的愛好）人各不同；各有所好
› If you put an amount of money each way on a horse race, you will win money if the horse you have chosen comes first, second, or third.
（下注的馬得前三名即贏的）一注三贏

example: When you run, each foot leaves the ground before the other comes down.
奔跑時，你的一隻腳在另一隻腳著地之前就離開了地面。
There are five leaflets - please take one of each.
有五種傳單——請每樣各拿一份。
Each of the companies supports a local charity.
這些公司都各自資助一個當地的慈善組織。
Each and every one of the flowers has its own colour and smell.
每一種花的色彩和氣味都各不相同。
We each (= every one of us) wanted the bedroom with the balcony, so we tossed a coin to decide.
我們大家都想住那間有陽臺的臥室，所以只好扔硬幣來決定。
The bill comes to £79, so that's about £10 each.
帳單共計79英鎊，平均分攤每人大約10英鎊。
You actually like modern jazz, do you? Each to their own.
你竟然喜歡現代爵士樂，真的？真是各有所好。

NONE: A2 used to show that each person in a group of two or more people does something to the others

example: They kept looking at each other and smiling.
他們一直微笑着著對方。
They're always wearing each other's clothes.
他們總是交換衣服穿。
Why are you always arguing with each other?
你們倆爲甚麽老是吵個不休？
They're so happy together - they were made for each other (= are perfectly matched).
他們在一起那麼幸福——真是天生一對。
